about_the_game:
Dive deeper into Moduwar with this Supporter Pack, filled with bonus content, behind-the-scenes extras, and special rewards to celebrate the game early access development and thank your support:

  • Exclusive Skins: Transform your Modu Heart with unique skins that give you a fresh look for your multiplayer matches and other game modes!

  • Original Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the world of Moduwar with the full OST

  • Lore Scroll - Archives of the Black Cloud: Dig deeper into the fascinating world of Moduwar with a lore scroll full of juicy backstory.

  • Modu Recipes Codex - Flavors of Arkadia: Four never-seen-before alien-inspired recipes to cook at home.

  • 3D Printable Models: Bring Arkadia world to life with exclusive 3D print files of in-game entities including two Modu organs and one spaceship. 

  • Behind-the-scene Video: Meet the Moduwar team, explore exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, and step aboard the spaceship set as the crew brings the FMV campaign cutscenes to life.

    Note: The game soundtrack, Lore Scroll, Modu Receips codex, 3D printable Models & Behind-the-scene video will be directly downloaded at the root of your Moduwar  game folder. Access your local folder of the game to get the files once you've purchased this supporter pack.

content_descriptors.notes: The Modu alien creatures are enslaved and are used as weapons of war. This is part of the main story-line of Moduwar and is being talked about throughout the game, mostly in cut-scenes.
